episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses the role of AI in real estate, emphasizing its limitations and the irreplaceable value of local knowledge. She shares insights on building trust with high-net-worth clients and how to leverage AI as a tool to enhance client interactions and property evaluations.
